members.name: Ingrid
members.thread: An events consultancy: contracts, run sheets and guest lists, with Companion Memory (beta).

members.name: Mats
members.thread: A freelance backend developer upstairs: clients, code and hours.

character.lede: A layered white modern villa stands on a canal, its picture-frame boxes topped by a floating roof slab over two dark pavilions. A carport terrace, a front balcony and a pool forecourt sit below a roof terrace.

spots.line: A modular sectional and a television stand fill the lounge under the roof.
A bistro table, two chairs and an easel stand on the balcony.
A breakfast bar and three stools sit in the kitchen.

facts.style: Layered white modern villa on a canal: picture-frame boxes with charcoal and taupe-board infill, a floating roof slab over two dark pavilions, a carport terrace, a front balcony and a pool forecourt

character.truths: The Core sits on a desk in the downstairs Study, in sight of the door. Television in the Living room and the Sky Lounge. Kitchen has an island. Pool forecourt, carport, balcony and roof terrace.
